data.long_meaning: The name Nolwenn is of Breton origin and means 'graceful'. It is a popular name in the Breton language and is often used in French-speaking regions as well. The name Nolwenn carries the meaning “Graceful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in Breton, French. Parents who choose Nolwenn usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the grace and beauty of the divine.
data.etymology: Nolwenn belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nolwenn total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
